plan.title: Block Unlocking Bids Before Technical Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared event's technical stage before evaluation has been completed.
Enable the configuration that blocks bid unlocking before technical evaluation is complete.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the prepared Tech+RFQ event.
Navigate to the RFQ stage where the locked commercial bids can be unlocked.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu containing Unlock Bids.
Confirm the Unlock Bids action is present before attempting it.

args.because: Bids can't be unlocked until technical evaluation is done

steps.note: Attempt to unlock the commercial bids and require Procol's refusal message before technical evaluation.
